# FAQ-010 Engineering FAQ #10

Revision: Rev A

Q: What is the required spindle warm-up for Hot Forge CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P1-L1-CN02) before first cut?
A: Allow the spindle warm-up time for Hot Forge CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P1-L1-CN02) to reach thermal stability. The spindle warm-up time for Hot Forge CNC turning center #2 (EQ-P1-L1-CN02) is 21 minutes. Follow machine run-in steps in SOP-P1-L1-01.

Q: What is the minimum coil cooling water flow for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03)?
A: Maintain coil cooling water flow at or above the coil cooling water flow minimum for Machining induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P2-L3-IH03), which is 72 L/min. Verify flow against instrument readings specified in MM-P2-L3-IH03-S3 and perform actions in SOP-P2-L3-02 if below limit.

Q: What is the minimum coil cooling water flow for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02)?
A: Maintain coil cooling water flow at or above the coil cooling water flow minimum for Ring Rolling induction billet heater #2 (EQ-P1-L2-IH02), which is 46 L/min. See MM-P2-L3-IH03-S3 for monitoring points and SOP-P2-L3-02 for corrective actions.

Q: What is the allowable quench delay for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03) after the cycle ends?
A: The quench delay maximum for Heat Treat heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P1-L4-HT03) is 15 seconds. If a delay approaches or exceeds this limit, follow stop-and-investigate steps in SOP-P1-L1-01 and document the event per SOP-P2-L3-02.

Q: What trigger value should be used for the dust collector alarm on Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2 (EQ-P3-L1-SB02)?
A: Set the dust collector pressure drop alarm to the dust collector pressure drop alarm for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2 (EQ-P3-L1-SB02), which is 2025 Pa. Confirm alarm setpoints and maintenance steps in SOP-P2-L3-02 and reference MM-P2-L3-IH03-S3 for related system drawings.
